description: Backs the higher-ranked side (by Sep 16 Global VRS snapshot) in every Finals match at the best verified price available, flat 25 units per bet.
rules: Eligible: every TWC 2026 Finals match with a verified moneyline/match-winner price.
Pick: team with the better (lower) Sep-16 Global VRS rank; ties = no bet.
Stake: flat 25.00 units. Max one position per match.
Price: must be captured with ticker/market id + observed_utc before first map starts; otherwise no bet.
Settlement: per market rule + HLTV/Liquipedia result cross-check.
notes: Pre-event: no verified prices exist, so no bets placed.

description: Backs the lower-ranked side (by Sep 16 Global VRS snapshot) in every Finals match, flat 15 units per bet. Profits if underdogs overperform.
rules: Eligible: every TWC 2026 Finals match with a verified match-winner price.

description: Bets only when the market price implies a win chance at least 8 points below a VRS-gap heuristic: favorite fair = 50% + 2.5% per VRS-rank gap (capped 85%). Stakes 20 units.
rules: Fair(favorite) = min(85%, 50% + 2.5% * (underdog_vrs - favorite_vrs)). Fair(underdog) = 1 - fair(favorite).
Bet the side whose market-implied probability is >= 8.0 points below its fair value.
Implied probability from decimal odds = 1 / decimal_odds; from prediction shares = share price.
Stake: flat 20.00 units. Max one position per match; no bet if neither side clears the edge bar.
Price + settlement rules identical to sim_favorite_backer.
notes: Heuristic is transparent but unproven; labeled analysis, not fact.

description: Targets variance from the 7-map pool: backs underdogs ONLY in group-stage openers (unpredictable vetoes), 12 units flat. Skips playoffs.
rules: Eligible: group-stage opening matches only (4 matches expected).

Stake: flat 12.00 units. No playoff bets by design.
Price + settlement rules identical to sim_favorite_backer.
notes: Thesis: new-map veto variance favors dogs early. Unproven; labeled analysis.
